title: Report: Jonathan Jones is in "advanced talks" to leave CBS for The Athletic

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Jonathan Jones is in "advanced talks" to leave CBS for The Athletic
sources.description: In last week's lengthy article from the New York Times about Dianna Russini, the former NFL insider at The Athletic, a Times Company spokesperson said as to the possibility that The Athletic will hire a new NFL insider: “Not something I can confirm at that level of detail at this point.”
